verdict.rationale: Granola documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to your meeting notes, letting them query notes, search transcripts, find topics from past meetings and get meeting insights. The probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: no evidence of OAuth as the auth method for MCP, no explicit mention of action-item retrieval via MCP, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration.
